descriptions.step on something: find a sturdy elevate stable object or platform such as a table, chair, stool, or bench strong enough to step on and reach top shelf
descriptions.sit comfortably: find a soft cushioned ergonomic comfortable seating furniture such as a couch, sofa, armchair, or bed for relaxed seating
descriptions.place flowers: find an upright watertight decorative container or vessel such as a vase, jug, cup, or bowl suitable for holding flower stems with water
descriptions.get potatoes out of fire: find a long heat-resistant implement, utensil, or tongs such as a fork, knife, spoon, or metal tool to retrieve hot potatoes safely
descriptions.water plant: find a portable liquid container or vessel such as a bottle, cup, bowl, or jug with an opening to carry water and pour over soil
descriptions.get lemon out of tea: find a small grasping or scooping utensil such as a spoon, fork, or tongs to lift a lemon slice from hot tea liquid
descriptions.dig hole: find a sturdy rigid scooping or penetrating tool such as a shovel, spade, spoon, or knife to displace dirt, soil, or earth
descriptions.open bottle of beer: find a rigid pry tool or lever with firm edge such as a bottle opener, knife, key, or sturdy metal edge to pry bottle crown cap
descriptions.open parcel: find a sharp cutting blade, edge, or shear tool such as a knife, scissors, or razor blade to slice open package tape and cardboard boxes
descriptions.serve wine: find an appropriate glassware goblet or drinking vessel such as a stemmed wine glass or clear drinking cup to pour and enjoy wine
descriptions.pour sugar: find a small scooping utensil or container with dispenser spout such as a spoon, cup, or bowl to transfer and sprinkle granulated sugar
descriptions.smear butter: find a flat-bladed spreading utensil or knife such as a butter knife, table knife, or flat spatula to spread softened butter evenly
descriptions.extinguish fire: find a firefighting vessel, smothering fabric, or extinguishing agent such as a fire hydrant, water bottle, blanket, or fire extinguisher
descriptions.pound carpet: find a long rigid club, stick, or paddle implement such as a baseball bat, stick, paddle, or carpet beater to vigorously strike hanging carpets
